purpose: A/B listening fixtures for comparing one-step LLM generation against MusicalPlan + critic generation.
comparison_method: Generate each case once with the current planner+critic pipeline.
Generate a control build with planner/critic disabled or from a pre-P0-0f commit.
Import bassline, arpeggio, and melody into the same DAW project at the declared BPM.
Score motif clarity, repetition fatigue, chord coherence, section arc, and track separation after 16 bars.

cases.name: am_progressive_midset
cases.expected_improvement: less static melody contour, clearer bass root anchor, more intentional section 9-12 tension

cases.name: dm_dorian_peak
cases.expected_improvement: raised-sixth Dorian color appears as planned tension instead of random passing tone

cases.name: g_mixolydian_festival
cases.expected_improvement: brighter hook contour, stronger flat-seventh payoff, fewer arp/melody collisions
